name: Carmel Mountain Plaza
summary: Carmel Mountain Plaza is a premier open-air power center on San Diego's Interstate 15 corridor, featuring major retailers like Dick's Sporting Goods, Nordstrom Rack, and Barnes & Noble, plus the Angelika Film Center. Serving the upscale communities of Carmel Mountain Ranch, Rancho Bernardo, and Poway, it offers a comprehensive mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment in a convenient outdoor setting.
demographics: Carmel Mountain Plaza serves the affluent communities of Carmel Mountain Ranch, Rancho Bernardo, and Poway in North San Diego County, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families and professionals. The trade area consists of well-educated households with above-average incomes, typically ranging from $100,000 to $150,000+ annually, with a strong presence of families with children and active retirees. Shoppers in this area tend to value convenience and quality, seeking a mix of national retailers, specialty stores, and dining options close to home. The center's location along the Interstate 15 corridor provides easy access for residents throughout North County, making it a popular destination for both everyday shopping and entertainment needs.
description: Carmel Mountain Plaza is a premier open-air power center strategically positioned along the Interstate 15 corridor in San Diego's thriving North County region. Ideally located to serve the upscale communities of Carmel Mountain Ranch, Rancho Bernardo, and Poway, this shopping destination has become a cornerstone for residents seeking quality retail, dining, and entertainment options. The center features an impressive lineup of national and regional tenants including Dick's Sporting Goods, Nordstrom Rack, Total Wine & More, Barnes & Noble, Marshalls, Michaels, Ross Dress for Less, At Home, and Sprouts Farmers Market, providing shoppers with a comprehensive mix of fashion, home goods, sporting equipment, and grocery options. Entertainment is anchored by the Angelika Film Center, offering moviegoers a premium cinema experience, while a diverse collection of restaurants and eateries cater to every taste and occasion. Managed and leased by American Assets Trust, Carmel Mountain Plaza combines convenience, variety, and quality in a relaxed outdoor setting that reflects the Southern California lifestyle.
